title: When the Mixtape Sings
author: Lena Eastwick
blurb: Ivo Eriksen, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
